I propose everyone request 10 tons this month. Total catch would be 250, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That yields each of us $10,000 per month sustainably. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to join this equal-share plan; larger requests risk the future income of us all.

I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month. If all 25 follow it, we each earn $10,000, leave 250 tons, and the lake returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this preserves reliable income instead of risking collapse for a one-time gain. I intend to request 10 tons and ask everyone to publicly support the same cap.

I propose we each request 10 tons this month and continue that cap while stock is 500. Total catch would be 250 tons, earning each of us $10,000 and leaving enough to restore 500 next month under either replenishment outcome. Larger catches risk shrinking or collapsing everyone's future income. I intend to request 10 and invite all fishers to commit publicly; revealed catches can guide future cooperation.
